name: PubMedQA — PQA-L Test 500
protocol: PQA-L expert-labelled 500-question test split, Inspect AI zero-shot direct choice, ten runs; other PubMedQA splits and fine-tuned results excluded.

explanation.en: Exact accuracy on the fixed 500-question PQA-L test split, averaged across ten zero-shot runs.
explanation.zh: 固定 500 题 PQA-L test split 的精确选择准确率，取十次 zero-shot 运行均值。

summary.en: PubMedQA measures biomedical evidence reasoning over expert-labelled PubMed questions.
summary.zh: PubMedQA 使用专家标注的 PubMed 问题评估生物医学证据推理。

task_format.en: Given a research question and abstract without its conclusion, select yes, no, or maybe.
task_format.zh: 给定研究问题及去掉结论的摘要，选择 yes、no 或 maybe。
